verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a compliance automation platform, so HR-synced onboarding and offboarding tracking is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never mentions HR system integrations, employee lifecycle checklists, security-training completion tracking, or offboarding access-revocation proof. The closest material covers periodic access reviews, policy acknowledgment and generic integrations, none of which treats hires or leavers as compliance events.
